---
title: Theme and Colors
description: Theme tokens and fonts
---

## Theme switching

Switch to the dark theme with `document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark'`.

## Text color tokens

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--nui-text-primary` | #1A1A1A | Headings and primary text |
| `--nui-text-body` | #22201C | Body copy |
| `--nui-text-secondary` | #4A4742 | Subhead、secondary text |
| `--nui-text-muted` | #6E6A63 | Caption、annotations |
| `--nui-text-quote` | #2E2A24 | Quote body |

## Background and rule tokens

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--nui-bg-page` | #F7F4ED | Warm off-white page background |
| `--nui-bg-surface` | #FBF9F4 | Secondary panel background |
| `--nui-rule-hairline` | #C9C2B2 | Hairline dividers |
| `--nui-rule-decorative` | #1A1A1A | Decorative emphasis rules |
| `--nui-highlight` | #F2E9C8 | Vintage newspaper yellow |

## Accent color tokens

| Token | Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--nui-accent-primary` | #7A1F1F | Brick red, Kicker / Masthead accents |
| `--nui-accent-ink-blue` | #1B2A4A | The Times blue |
| `--nui-highlight` | #F2E9C8 | Highlight background |

## Font families

| Token | Font | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--font-family-masthead` | Cormorant Garamond | Mastheads |
| `--font-family-blackletter` | UnifrakturMaguntia | Blackletter preset |
| `--font-family-display` | Source Serif 4 | Display display headlines |
| `--font-family-headline` | Source Serif 4 | Headline / Subhead |
| `--font-family-body` | Source Serif 4 | Body copy |
| `--font-family-meta` | Inter | Small-caps metadata |
